about: Curated list of the research / learning tools across the 5 repos for the Admin Board (pages/29_🧭_Admin_Board.py, owner 2026-11-22). Hand-maintained: add a tool here when a research workflow is added. Live state (enabled, last run, conclusion) comes from the GitHub Actions API at render time; 'record' names the smallest committed file that shows the tool's forward / learning record (read at render time from the repo's raw URL, or for wowza-exec through the read-only store token). A gate is the number the record is measured against, with the source that sets it. Names and schedules only: no price is read or shown.

tools.name: Prediction ledger (v9 models)
tools.schedule: predict every 15-30 min; settle 9x a day
tools.purpose: Stores every fixture x market prediction of every v9 model as a learning ledger (no bets) and settles it.

tools.name: Corners / cards models
tools.purpose: Learning-only count models for corners and cards on two-source-verified leagues; never tip.
tools.record_note: No sample gate; data-verification gates in config/side_models.json.

tools.name: Props R2 challengers
tools.purpose: Legacy vs repaired props recipe, replayed; tracked forward in the prediction ledger. No promotion.

tools.name: TOP-3 per league (live record)
tools.schedule: freeze before kickoff (predict); settle 9x a day
tools.purpose: T1/T2/T3 per league per gameweek, frozen at first sight and settled.
tools.record_note: Gate 150 picks (reached_min_picks in the TOP-3 research module).

tools.name: League weekly research panel
tools.schedule: panel in predict; settle 9x a day
tools.purpose: Weekly per-league research panel, true forward from 2026-10-25.
tools.record_note: Not enough data below 30 priced settled rows or 8 gameweeks (src/research/league_weekly_eval.py).

tools.name: O/U 2.5 shadow (v9 vs v9.1 vs Pro)
tools.purpose: Settles the O/U 2.5 shadow comparison of v9, v9.1 and the Pro model.

tools.name: Bars monthly proposals
tools.purpose: Re-selects every league's bars each month as a proposal; nothing serves until the owner applies it.

tools.name: Data Truth collect
tools.purpose: Collects the real-data inputs the Data Truth stoplight checks.

tools.name: EFL research
tools.purpose: EFL diagnosis (Championship / League One / League Two): branch research/efl-diagnosis-1118.
tools.record_note: Branch research/efl-diagnosis-1118 (last commit 2026-11-18); no forward record yet.

tools.name: Player V3 forward test
tools.purpose: Pre-registered forward test of the V3 player-prop market-residual rule.
tools.record_note: Gate 150 bets per market: src/player_v3/forward.py N_MIN.

tools.name: Specials (high scores, 0-0, unusual scores)
tools.purpose: Logs specials candidates against each league's base rates and collects their prices (research).
tools.record_note: Read from branch data-truth-100 (the collector commits there). Verdict needs 30 candidate events (src/specials/study.py).

tools.name: League scout
tools.schedule: every 2 h (+ closing prices every 3 h)
tools.purpose: Forward prices and results for ~200 leagues not yet bet, to find the next leagues.
tools.record_note: League states in output/scout/league_status.json: COLLECTING < 100 settled with a genuine close, EARLY 100-299, READABLE 300+ (src/scout/report.py).

tools.name: Pro tip scoreboard
tools.purpose: Scores the 1X2 and Bet Builder tips Pro sends.

tools.name: Price trader lab
tools.purpose: Price-trading / arbitrage lab with a no-stake trading engine.
tools.record_note: Gate: 150 completed trades and 30 match days (registry/price_trader/registration_v1.json).

tools.name: 1X2 forward record
tools.purpose: Forward no-stake record of the Pro 1X2 model against the available price.

tools.name: Low-edge shadow
tools.purpose: Logs every pre-kickoff v9 candidate with edge >= 0 and settles it (edge reassessment).

tools.name: Learned per-league tiers (challenger)
tools.purpose: Weekly per-league tier challenger against the v9 bars.

tools.name: Props learner study
tools.purpose: Non-inferiority test of a new learner per props market.

tools.name: Pure prediction lab
tools.purpose: Weekly leakage-safe re-evaluation of pure prediction quality.

tools.name: Pro studies (daily)
tools.purpose: Argentina BTTS, BTTS regime, O/U studies and the O/U challenger forward log.

tools.name: Research index
tools.purpose: Every study's latest verdict in one file (feeds the Research page).

tools.name: Standard repair loop
tools.purpose: Forensic rebuild of the Standard model plus its weekly loop.

tools.name: 1X2 clean retrain
tools.purpose: Monthly 1X2 retrain on clean data (no stake).

tools.name: Weekly league promotion review
tools.purpose: Reviews scouted leagues for promotion to the bet universe (proposals only).

tools.name: v11 market-first shadow
tools.purpose: Records what the market-first engine would decide (collection only) and its CLV.
tools.record_note: Gate MIN_CLV_N = 150 clean CLV observations per segment (v11 config.py). Shadow picks: output/v11_scoreboard.csv.

tools.name: v11 prediction ledger (private)
tools.purpose: v11 shadow predictions ledger, kept in the private repo.
tools.record_note: Read with the read-only store token (private).

tools.name: Sharp book capture (SF-1)
tools.schedule: every 2 h (only when its enable switch is on)
tools.purpose: Per-book O/U snapshots at T-72h / T-6h / close plus a no-stake ledger (private store).
tools.record_note: Credit floor 100,000; 900 Actions minutes a month.

tools.name: OddsAPI history collect
tools.purpose: Buys historical odds into the private branch odds-history.
tools.record_note: Credit floor 260,000 (workflow header); run ledgers in ledger/runs/ on branch odds-history.

tools.name: Cloudbet shadow (dry)
tools.purpose: Dry Cloudbet measurement: logs what it would do, places nothing.
tools.record_note: No record file committed (exec main has only output/.gitkeep).
